name: How much does it really cost to build an ADU in Los Angeles County right now?

mainEntity.name: How much does it really cost to build an ADU in Los Angeles County right now?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Most ADUs in Los Angeles County cost **low-to-mid six figures**, with cost per square foot often similar to a small custom home. A realistic budget for many homeowners is roughly what you’d expect for a full new build, not a simple remodel.

Costs vary widely by size, type of ADU, and complexity of the site and utilities. Soft costs (design, engineering, permits, fees) are also significant and often underestimated.

Key factors:
- Size and type: garage conversion vs new detached build
- Site conditions: grading, access, utility trenching, panel upgrades
- Level of finish: basic rental vs high-end “family suite”
- Soft costs: plans, structural calculations, Title 24, permits, impact/utility fees

To get a meaningful number, define your target size and purpose, then get itemized estimates covering both construction and soft costs. Treat any “too good to be true” quote with caution and insist on written scopes and allowances.

An experienced ADU builder in LA County can benchmark your project against recent local builds so you’re budgeting in the right range.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Los Angeles County, most ADUs end up in the low-to-mid six figures, with cost per square foot similar to a small custom home. Garage conversions are usually the least expensive, detached new builds the most. Always budget for design, engineering, permits, and utility upgrades on top of pure construction costs.
